LanguageData.APM_Mech_Tinker.label: Tinker
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Tinker.description: The tinker is a mechanoid that is suited for repair. It can aid in fixing buildings, as well as assist in repair jobs for mechanitor controlled mechs. In a pinch, it can project a shield on a nearby ally as well as blind enemies in a radius around a laser it can cast.
